entries.name: Classical mask between fruit-filled cornucopias

previous_recipe.notes: Observed historical impression, uniformly scaled. Catalogue labels excluded; documented erasures remove only separate type and neighbouring fragments. Three vector tones interpret observed scan strength.

current_recipe.notes: Preferred complete repeated impression No.380, PDF/archive303; the original No.322-a identity remains stable. Uniform source-aspect scale and original1928-unit advance; no shear or drawn repairs. The isolated18-pixel paper fleck above the upper-left fruit is excluded by a documented crop-local erasure. Three tones interpret native ink strength.

entries.identity_evidence: The face, individual fruit arrangements, ribbons, horn curls, hanging garlands and small upper-right H-shaped mark correspond in both complete impressions. Impression differences do not create a separate icon.
entries.quality_evidence: No.380 preserves more distinct eye detail, fine horn hatching, leaf separations and hanging end marks. Threshold135 retains these without the thicker145 fringe;125 is retained as a rejected lighter alternative. No.322-a remains a complete comparison witness.
entries.classification_evidence: The centre is a human mask, not a third fruit bowl; the flanking fruit-filled vessels continue into curved horn bodies. The earlier sofa sentence was copied from the separate repeated furniture entry and did not describe this design.

cleanup.reason: Isolated paper fleck above the upper-left fruit, inspected in enlarged native context; no artwork removed.

entries.geometry: Uniform physical source aspect ratio; existing1928-unit advance preserved. No nonuniform stretching, assumed squaring or drawn repairs. The two native impressions have slightly different scanned proportions.
entries.format_review: Single-glyph OTF/TTF/WOFF/WOFF2 review fits existing vertical metrics and1928advance. Native, monochrome, tonal and actual font sizes32/64/128/256/512px inspected. Full-family generated outputs and browser review remain part of the collection release checks.
